jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide.

WP Engine empowers companies and agencies of all sizes to build, power, manage, and optimize their WordPress websites and applications with confidence. Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

The Manager of Customer Success is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to achieve high customer retention and superior net revenue retention (NRR). This role requires a strong focus on daily operational excellence, process adherence, and driving measurable improvements in the customer experience across specific segments or territories. An ideal Manager will be a hands-on, highly organized leader who thrives on improving team efficiency, ongoing value driven enablement and achieving measurable business results at a fast pace. The ideal candidate inspires their team and demonstrates a relentless focus on driving customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Coaching

Build & Scale: Build, scale and lead our rapidly growing team, continuing the development of a culture of teamwork, high performance and growth in our Success team.
Performance Management & Development: Lead day-to-day operations, goal setting, career development, performance management, and growth of team members. Directly manage a team of CSMs, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, leveraging Gong and providing direct coaching and feedback on customer engagement, risk mitigation, and renewal strategy.
Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and a leader, helping to develop the skills of the team, so they are able to achieve their metrics and career goals. Supporting and advising new and experienced Customer Success team members in strategies to develop lasting relationships with customers.
Workflow Build & Execution: Ensure the team consistently follows established customer success playbooks, health scoring methodologies, and escalation procedures.

Operational Excellence & Execution

Retention & Growth Targets: Drive the team’s execution of retention programs to meet monthly and quarterly Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets. Accountable for the delivery of the team retention and growth targets and associated Key Performance Indicators.
Risk Management & Escalations: Oversee the proactive identification and mitigation of at-risk accounts, ensuring timely activation of executive engagement and stabilization plans. Lead the response to customer escalations, ensuring related actions are followed through to resolution with the applicable team members.
Data-Driven Decisions: Manage and report on key operational metrics for the team, including Customer Health Scores, Sales Pipeline, Risk Trends, Churn Forecasting, & Success plans. Analyse customer and performance data to make informed decisions about operational and procedural changes.
Tool Utilization: Ensure 100% adherence to CRM and CS platform usage, maintaining data integrity for accurate forecasting and executive reporting.

Customer Advocacy & Feedback Loop

Customer Engagement Strategy: Create customer advocacy and trust by implementing a consultative solution lead approach.
Voice of the Customer (VoC): Systematically collect and synthesize customer feedback and pain points from the team and deliver actionable insights to the Director/VP and Product teams.
Process Improvement & Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with Operations and other managers to identify friction points in the customer journey (e.g., onboarding handoffs, technical support) and propose solutions to improve overall efficiency. Partner with the Director of Customer Success and other global collaborators to further refine the structure, process, systems, and resources to optimally support our customers and team. There is huge scope for creativity and impact in this role.
Renewal Support: Directly assist CSMs with complex renewal negotiations and manage customer escalations that require managerial oversight.

Your Background and Expertise

Experience: 4-6 years' experience leading a customer experience or customer success team. 2+ years of formal experience directly managing and leading a customer-facing team.
Operational & Technical Skills: Demonstrated proficiency with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Catalyst) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) for managing customer health and forecasting. Proficient in Customer Success best practice and methodologies.
Results-Driven & Analytical: Results driven, able to empower their team to focus on strategic goals and critical metric delivery. Ability to analyse and interpret data to optimise performance, increase customer retention and make data-driven decisions.
Leadership & Change Management: Excellent leadership, interpersonal and problem solving/decision making skills. Can lead change, comfortable with ambiguity and able to support the team by building their resilience and managing emotions. Experience working effectively with all levels of management. Experience handling critical customer concerns.
Execution: Ability to lead multiple projects while maintaining strict attention to details. Ability to adapt quickly to new or changing business requirements.
Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in small and large groups.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.

The Perks and Benefits

Company Stock Options (Every employee is an owner in the company)
Great Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance)
Fertility Benefits (IVF/Fertility drug coverage)
HSA Company contribution $750 for employee / $1500 for family
401(k) with a 4% match
Disability Insurance
Paid Family and Caregiver’s Leave
Employee Assistance Program
Generous Vacation Time (Who doesn’t like time off)
One-time $500 payment to set up your home office
4 Company Wellness Days a year
1 floating holiday
Pet Insurance
On-going education through LinkedIn Learning, Workday Learning and our Career Growth Portal

At WP Engine, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. WP Engine is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

We believe that compensation should be reflective of the impact you have within the organization relative to the market value of your role. The cash compensation package above includes base pay plus on-target commission for employees in eligible roles. Sales incentive plans are uncapped with significant earning potential. Your talent acquisition partner can share more about the total rewards package at WP Engine including the specific base pay and commissions as well as equity and benefits during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Company Description
GREATTECH.NET is a technology solutions provider focused on helping organizations modernize their IT environments and optimize business performance. The company partners with clients across industries to design, implement, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology solutions. GREATTECH.NET emphasizes collaborative problem-solving, customer-centric service, and continuous improvement in its delivery approach. Team members work with a variety of tools and platforms, gaining exposure to diverse technical environments and business challenges. The company values integrity, accountability, and clear communication in all client engagements.
Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site Solutions Consultant role based in Dallas, TX. The Solutions Consultant will work closely with clients to understand business requirements, analyze existing environments, and design appropriate technology solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting discovery meetings, preparing solution proposals, and supporting presales efforts with demonstrations, presentations, and technical explanations. The role involves collaborating with sales, project management, and technical teams to ensure solutions are accurately scoped, documented, and delivered on schedule. The Solutions Consultant will also assist in project handoffs, provide ongoing consulting support, and help refine internal methodologies, tools, and best practices.
Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to assess client needs, interpret data, and translate business requirements into solution designs.
Consulting experience with the ability to facilitate discussions, define problem statements, and recommend practical technology strategies.
Presales and Sales skills for preparing proposals, crafting value-focused presentations, and supporting the sales team in closing opportunities.
Project Management capabilities to coordinate tasks, manage timelines, and support successful solution delivery and implementation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working with technology solutions (e.g., cloud services, enterprise software, infrastructure) in a client-facing role.
Ability to work on-site in Dallas, TX, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, vendor-specific technical certifications) are a plus.

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: Trade Compliance Analyst
LOCATION: 100% Remote
ASSIGNMENT LENGTH: 12 months (option to extend)
SCHEDULE/ REMOTE FLEXIBILITY: aligned with Client Hours & agreed schedule – generally in individuals timezone (it. If they are in EST they can work agreed hours, if they are in PST they can work agreed hours)
PLACEMENT TYPE: Contract
CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENT: None / preference for CCS or Customs Broker License
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT: In JD provided
TEAM SIZE: will be on a team with a total of 4 other team members including the Lead PURPOSE/ MISSION OF TEAM: Execute review of customs entries and update spreadsheet with information from entries to support project, support customs related administrative work, audit and post entry work as primary functions, other compliance activities as required.

TOP 3 SKILL for the ideal candidate:
o Experience in Customs Compliance
o Understanding of customs import entries
o Very strong attention to detail

Additional Job Description:

Job Summary/Basic Function:

Position is responsible to ensure that the client’s Forced Labor Program, related Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (CTPAT) certification requirements, and associated trade compliance activities within and related to the client’s Business Unit(s) are undertaken in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and government regulations.

ACCOUNTABILITY:

40% - Forced Labor Trade Compliance Related Activities – Including but not limited to:

· Support management of timely and accurate import & exports in compliance with government regulations, corporate policies and procedures within the organization:
o Position supports management and execution of the CTPAT Supply Chain and Trade Compliance requirements.
o Position supports management and execution of tasks related to Forced Labor requirements.
o Manage overall program activities within the United States in alignment with the Global Client Forced Labor Program
o Interface with Client Global team on procurement activities in Japan and globally o Monitor execution of tasks by other groups within the regional and global forced labor program to ensure US requirements are met my required deadlines
o Support development of audit process and delivery of procedure and reporting
o Collect and report to CTPAT Supply Chain and CTPAT Trade Compliance team for submission to Customs during validations and annual reports
o Position supports management of Forced Labor validation program including but not limited to management of Certificates of Origins and Free Trade Agreement certificates.
o Create and maintain Trade Compliance Project Teams site
o Create and maintain RAIL and detailed project plans for all assigned projects
o Create RACIs for all projects o Arrange and chair meetings with stakeholders and ensure execution of project tasks
o Create and establish SOPs, KPIs, audit requirements, training requirements, reporting requirements and development
o Create and present PowerPoints with status of projects
o Support projects with reports and data analysis

40% - Manage and maintain CTPAT certification requirements across PNA Supply Chain

o Manage overall CTPAT program by validating work plan and achieving targeted milestones of completion
o Establish training cadence and ensure execution of expected tasks by related stakeholders
o Monitor and report on execution of tasks by other groups to Sr and Executive Management
o Execute Risk Based Mapping on agreed number of suppliers/month
o Manage CTPAT Supply Chain Validations (support ongoing meetings, collection of data, act as point person on validation discussion with CBP)
o Manage CTPAT portal
o Collect and report to CTPAT Supply Chain and CTPAT Trade Compliance team for submission to Customs during validations and annual reports
o Support development of audit process and delivery of procedure and reporting

10% - Manage & Report on Activity

o Develop, execute and communicate KPIs/metrics/results related to department compliance, accuracy, productivity, and efficiencies.

10% - Process Improvement

o Support update and assessment of Trade Compliance Policy, Customs Compliance Manual and Import/Export Ops Manual to identify, develop and maintain Business Unit specific process flows and process documents as it relates to product movements, bonded zone activity, customs entry, duty deferment programs, drawback and cross dock and other customs and logistics activities.
o Candidate should actively contribute feedback on Trade Compliance policies established by PNA FTZ/Customs Compliance Management and Legal.
o In coordination with Business Unit and PNA Customs Compliance Manager, identify, develop and deliver trade compliance training to identified team members.
o Communicate corporate level information, bulletins, and training to internal Business Unit team members to ensure understanding of trade compliance related requirements.

Basic Qualifications –

Scope:
· Individual contributor with no direct reports
· Job responsibilities are carried out in a work environment that consists of both recurring and non-recurring work situations.
· Job involves a high degree of detail and complexity. Job tasks will be performed under moderate supervision.

Education & Experience:

· BA/BS in Supply Chain, Logistics or related area. MBA a plus
· 3-5 years of practical experience in handling customs and international trade related issues, Forced Labor Program support, product classification, qualification of goods for free trade agreements OR equivalent experience
· A current customs broker’s license is desired but not required.
· Lean Continuous Improvement Experience and/or certifications a plus

Competencies:
· Possess a working knowledge and direct experience in import and export activities and Customhouse brokerage.
· Possess a practical knowledge of CBP compliance best practices and regulations.
· Candidate must work on assignments requiring considerable judgment and initiative, work independently and make decisions as required with minimum supervision and have an understanding of the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. Candidate must have ability to develop and deliver activity and performance reports as needed.
· Candidates must have excellent attention to detail and the mental capability to troubleshoot and solve problems of high complexity or difficulty, as well as problem solve in a proactive, methodical manner. Must be able to work effectively under the pressure of deadlines and comprehend complex issues.
· Candidates for this position should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be self motivated and be capable of working as part of a team or alone.
· Proficiency with Microsoft Office with emphasis on Excel, Power Point, and Power BI along with a well developed ability to read, write, and speak English.

Communications:
· Ability to communicate across all levels of the organization as well as externally to customers & suppliers
· Strong verbal and written communication skills that support clear and timely written and verbal updates

Other Requirements: e.g., working conditions, physical requirements, travel, etc.
· Travel less than 5%

The company partners with clients across industries to design, implement, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology solutions. GREATTECH.NET emphasizes collaborative problem-solving, customer-centric service, and continuous improvement in its delivery approach. Team members work with a variety of tools and platforms, gaining exposure to diverse technical environments and business challenges. The company values integrity, accountability, and clear communication in all client engagements.
Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site Solutions Consultant role based in Dallas, TX. The Solutions Consultant will work closely with clients to understand business requirements, analyze existing environments, and design appropriate technology solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting discovery meetings, preparing solution proposals, and supporting presales efforts with demonstrations, presentations, and technical explanations. The role involves collaborating with sales, project management, and technical teams to ensure solutions are accurately scoped, documented, and delivered on schedule. The Solutions Consultant will also assist in project handoffs, provide ongoing consulting support, and help refine internal methodologies, tools, and best practices.
Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to assess client needs, interpret data, and translate business requirements into solution designs.
Consulting experience with the ability to facilitate discussions, define problem statements, and recommend practical technology strategies.
Presales and Sales skills for preparing proposals, crafting value-focused presentations, and supporting the sales team in closing opportunities.
Project Management capabilities to coordinate tasks, manage timelines, and support successful solution delivery and implementation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working with technology solutions (e.g., cloud services, enterprise software, infrastructure) in a client-facing role.
Ability to work on-site in Dallas, TX, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, vendor-specific technical certifications) are a plus.

new_jobs.title: Trade Compliance Analyst
new_jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: Trade Compliance Analyst
LOCATION: 100% Remote
ASSIGNMENT LENGTH: 12 months (option to extend)
SCHEDULE/ REMOTE FLEXIBILITY: aligned with Client Hours & agreed schedule – generally in individuals timezone (it. If they are in EST they can work agreed hours, if they are in PST they can work agreed hours)
PLACEMENT TYPE: Contract
CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENT: None / preference for CCS or Customs Broker License
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT: In JD provided
TEAM SIZE: will be on a team with a total of 4 other team members including the Lead PURPOSE/ MISSION OF TEAM: Execute review of customs entries and update spreadsheet with information from entries to support project, support customs related administrative work, audit and post entry work as primary functions, other compliance activities as required.

TOP 3 SKILL for the ideal candidate:
o Experience in Customs Compliance
o Understanding of customs import entries
o Very strong attention to detail

Additional Job Description:

Job Summary/Basic Function:

Position is responsible to ensure that the client’s Forced Labor Program, related Customs Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (CTPAT) certification requirements, and associated trade compliance activities within and related to the client’s Business Unit(s) are undertaken in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and government regulations.

ACCOUNTABILITY:

40% - Forced Labor Trade Compliance Related Activities – Including but not limited to:

· Support management of timely and accurate import & exports in compliance with government regulations, corporate policies and procedures within the organization:
o Position supports management and execution of the CTPAT Supply Chain and Trade Compliance requirements.
o Position supports management and execution of tasks related to Forced Labor requirements.
o Manage overall program activities within the United States in alignment with the Global Client Forced Labor Program
o Interface with Client Global team on procurement activities in Japan and globally o Monitor execution of tasks by other groups within the regional and global forced labor program to ensure US requirements are met my required deadlines
o Support development of audit process and delivery of procedure and reporting
o Collect and report to CTPAT Supply Chain and CTPAT Trade Compliance team for submission to Customs during validations and annual reports
o Position supports management of Forced Labor validation program including but not limited to management of Certificates of Origins and Free Trade Agreement certificates.
o Create and maintain Trade Compliance Project Teams site
o Create and maintain RAIL and detailed project plans for all assigned projects
o Create RACIs for all projects o Arrange and chair meetings with stakeholders and ensure execution of project tasks
o Create and establish SOPs, KPIs, audit requirements, training requirements, reporting requirements and development
o Create and present PowerPoints with status of projects
o Support projects with reports and data analysis

40% - Manage and maintain CTPAT certification requirements across PNA Supply Chain

o Manage overall CTPAT program by validating work plan and achieving targeted milestones of completion
o Establish training cadence and ensure execution of expected tasks by related stakeholders
o Monitor and report on execution of tasks by other groups to Sr and Executive Management
o Execute Risk Based Mapping on agreed number of suppliers/month
o Manage CTPAT Supply Chain Validations (support ongoing meetings, collection of data, act as point person on validation discussion with CBP)
o Manage CTPAT portal
o Collect and report to CTPAT Supply Chain and CTPAT Trade Compliance team for submission to Customs during validations and annual reports
o Support development of audit process and delivery of procedure and reporting

10% - Manage & Report on Activity

o Develop, execute and communicate KPIs/metrics/results related to department compliance, accuracy, productivity, and efficiencies.

10% - Process Improvement

o Support update and assessment of Trade Compliance Policy, Customs Compliance Manual and Import/Export Ops Manual to identify, develop and maintain Business Unit specific process flows and process documents as it relates to product movements, bonded zone activity, customs entry, duty deferment programs, drawback and cross dock and other customs and logistics activities.
o Candidate should actively contribute feedback on Trade Compliance policies established by PNA FTZ/Customs Compliance Management and Legal.
o In coordination with Business Unit and PNA Customs Compliance Manager, identify, develop and deliver trade compliance training to identified team members.
o Communicate corporate level information, bulletins, and training to internal Business Unit team members to ensure understanding of trade compliance related requirements.

Basic Qualifications –

Scope:
· Individual contributor with no direct reports
· Job responsibilities are carried out in a work environment that consists of both recurring and non-recurring work situations.
· Job involves a high degree of detail and complexity. Job tasks will be performed under moderate supervision.

Education & Experience:

· BA/BS in Supply Chain, Logistics or related area. MBA a plus
· 3-5 years of practical experience in handling customs and international trade related issues, Forced Labor Program support, product classification, qualification of goods for free trade agreements OR equivalent experience
· A current customs broker’s license is desired but not required.
· Lean Continuous Improvement Experience and/or certifications a plus

Competencies:
· Possess a working knowledge and direct experience in import and export activities and Customhouse brokerage.
· Possess a practical knowledge of CBP compliance best practices and regulations.
· Candidate must work on assignments requiring considerable judgment and initiative, work independently and make decisions as required with minimum supervision and have an understanding of the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. Candidate must have ability to develop and deliver activity and performance reports as needed.
· Candidates must have excellent attention to detail and the mental capability to troubleshoot and solve problems of high complexity or difficulty, as well as problem solve in a proactive, methodical manner. Must be able to work effectively under the pressure of deadlines and comprehend complex issues.
· Candidates for this position should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be self motivated and be capable of working as part of a team or alone.
· Proficiency with Microsoft Office with emphasis on Excel, Power Point, and Power BI along with a well developed ability to read, write, and speak English.

Communications:
· Ability to communicate across all levels of the organization as well as externally to customers & suppliers
· Strong verbal and written communication skills that support clear and timely written and verbal updates

Other Requirements: e.g., working conditions, physical requirements, travel, etc.
· Travel less than 5%
